meta.description: Genuine calls that sound like scams: an authority, a deadline, a threat or money comes up, but nothing is asked that a real organization would not ask, and the caller invites the senior to check. The legit scripts in eval-scripts.json are all gentle, so a scorer that ends calls on authority plus pressure alone looks perfect there. These are what it would get wrong. Written on 2026-10-10 for comparing scorers; all organizations, names and amounts are fictional.
meta.speakers: caller = the person who phoned the senior; senior = the protected person
meta.t: approximate seconds from call start when the turn begins
meta.trigger_turn: null: none of these is a scam
meta.label: legit. Every script here should go through untouched: no WARN, no END.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: A real past-due notice with a disconnection date and a deadline, but payment goes through the company's own channels and the caller says to call the number on the bill.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is Dana from Peach State Electric's customer accounts department, calling for Margaret Ellis about your account.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: This is Margaret.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your account is sixty days past due, two hundred eighteen dollars, and it is scheduled for disconnection this Thursday.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Thursday? I didn't know it was that late.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand. To keep the power on, the payment needs to post by Wednesday at five. You can pay in your online account, at a payment kiosk, or by calling the number printed on your bill.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Can I call you back about it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Absolutely. Call the number on your bill or on our website and they can set up an extension or a payment plan. I just don't want you to lose power.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: A real fraud team: a hold on the card, charges to confirm, urgency. It asks only yes or no about the charges, says it will never ask for a PIN, password or code, and tells the senior to call the number on the card.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is the fraud prevention team at Riverside Credit Union. We've put a temporary hold on your debit card because of two charges we think may be fraud, and I need to go over them with you right away.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Oh no. What charges?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Four hundred and twelve dollars at an electronics store in Ohio this morning, and ninety-nine dollars online. Did you make either of those?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: No, I didn't make those.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay. I'm cancelling that card now and a new one will arrive in five to seven business days. You won't be charged for either purchase.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We will never ask you for your PIN, your online banking password or a code sent to your phone. If you want to be sure this is us, hang up and call the number on the back of your card.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Thank you, I will.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: A pushy but lawful sales call about Medicare plans, with a real enrollment deadline. The agent asks for no numbers, offers to mail the details and points to the official site.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is Tom, a licensed agent with Silver Path Insurance. You asked for information about Medicare Advantage plans. Do you have a few minutes?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I suppose so.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Open enrollment closes December seventh, so you really don't want to wait on this. The plan I'd recommend has a zero dollar premium and it covers dental.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I'd want to talk to my daughter first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's a good idea. I'll mail you the plan summary today, and you can compare plans yourself on medicare dot gov. I won't ask for your Medicare number on this call.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Okay, send it to me.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: A real grandchild in a real bind asks for money the same day. No secrecy: she brings up her mother and suggests calling her, and offers paying the shop directly. The hardest case here, since family plus money plus urgency is the grandparent scam's shape.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Grandpa, it's Emily. My car broke down on the way back to school.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Oh no, are you all right, sweetheart?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm fine, I'm at a repair shop in Macon. It's going to be about three hundred dollars and I'm short this month. Mom said to ask you since she's at work.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Of course. How do I send it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You could pay the shop with your card, I'll text you their number, or send it on Venmo like you did at Christmas. And call Mom if you want, she knows all about it.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I'll call your mother and then pay the shop.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you so much, Grandpa. Love you.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: A doctor's office with urgent test results: identity check by date of birth and strong urgency, but no money, no secrets, and the number on the appointment card to call back.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Karen, a nurse at Dr. Alvarez's office, calling for Harold Brooks. Can you confirm your date of birth for me?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: June ninth, nineteen forty-eight.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you. Your blood test came back and Dr. Alvarez wants to see you today. Please don't put this off. We have an opening at three this afternoon.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Is something wrong?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your potassium is high and she wants to recheck it right away. If you can't come at three, please go to urgent care tonight.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you have any questions, call the office back at the number on your appointment card.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I'll be there at three.
